class.name: NNSensor
class.brief_description: Measures a piece of game state and exposes it as a [code]0..1[/code] input for considerations.
class.description: Add as a child of an [NNAgent], [NNBTRoot], [NNSTRoot], or [NNSensorGroup] to supply reusable input values to one or more [NNConsideration] nodes. Use a sensor when multiple considerations need the same measurement (such as distance to the player) so it is calculated once per evaluation and shared across behaviours. Set [member NNSensors.sensor_value] directly on a base [NNSensor], or use one of the built-in subclasses (such as [NNBlackboardSensor], [NNFloatRangeSensor], or [NNDistanceVector3Sensor]).
